fields.description: Issue includes Wen IL PHILLIPS' "NOTEBOOK" column with commentary on baseball (including 3rd-baseman Owen and Judge Landis), local Miami Beach political controversy involving arrests and elections, and references to federal involvement. Contains extensive radio program schedules for WQAM/WIOD and a horse-racing column ("HORSE SENSE" / "JOCKEY JIMMY") with track dates and betting tips. Also includes local society/club notes, poems and humor pieces, and numerous advertisements for Miami and Miami Beach businesses, nightlife venues, and services.
